title: batch_plan
description: The auto-analysis producer's output (#57): a dependency plan over an ALREADY-FILED, independently-authored batch of issues. The model authors it during a conversation (see the batch-plan skill) after inspecting candidate issue bodies; batch_plan consumes it — validating the DAG and adding the tasks to a run. Unlike a spec (#18), the tasks already exist as issues; task_id is a real issue ref (#N), not a local id.

tasks.description: the per-issue plan, in any order; batch_plan topologically orders it for scheduling

task_id.description: the real issue ref (e.g. #42) or task-source id this entry plans

depends_on.description: task_ids this one depends on — each must be another task in the plan or an already-terminal known issue id

pipeline.description: lane preset for this task (docs-only -> micro, small mechanical -> lite, risky/cross-cutting -> full); null uses the run's default lane

deterministic_stages.description: stages to run on the $0 ENGINE lane instead of a model (e.g. test/deliver for a docs-only task); null takes the preset's default, where TEST runs no model; [] is the explicit choice of a model for every stage

model.description: per-task model pin (#84): a friendly alias (fable/opus/sonnet/haiku) or an exact model id, e.g. 'fable' for an architecture-heavy task. Must belong to the task's provider (a codex-tagged task pins a codex id); null keeps the role default

effort.description: per-task reasoning-effort pin (#96), overriding the stage-spec defaults; null keeps the stage defaults

implementation_budget.description: per-task IMPLEMENT wall-clock budget (#615): 'long' gives a large task 60 minutes instead of the project default (30 unless the adapter sets implement_timeout_s), 'short' 15 minutes. A pin wins over SCOPE's own sizing; null keeps the default and lets SCOPE size it

review_budget.description: per-task REVIEW wall-clock budget (#624): 'long' gives a large change 30 minutes instead of the project default (10 unless the adapter sets review_timeout_s); 'standard' keeps the default and turns off diff-size scaling. null keeps the default, which a diff of 1500+ changed lines raises to long

keep_issue_open.description: true when merging this task's PR does not finish its issue: DELIVER writes 'Part of #N' and refuses a PR that would close it (#613). false overrides a keep-open label; null or absent follows the project's keep-open labels.

rationale.description: why these edges/lane were chosen — the model's analysis, human-visible
